role: Pydantic data models for similarity computation results and events in the Co-Being knowledge graph.
detail: Defines two frozen (immutable) BaseModel types: SimilarityResult (pairwise similarity score between two nodes with cosine/Euclidean similarity in [0.0, 1.0], includes source_node_id, target_node_id, similarity_score clamped via field_validator, and embedding_key defaulting to "embedding") and SimilarityComputedEvent (emitted after similarity pipeline processes one instance node, tracks observed_node_id, edges_created >= 0, label_raw, and correlation_id for tracing). The SimilarityResult validator _clamp_similarity_score silently clamps floating-point arithmetic artifacts (e.g., 1.0000000002 → 1.0, -0.0000001 → 0.0) to prevent spurious validation errors. Both models are produced/consumed by Epic 4 T043 similarity computation, knowledge graph writer, and Layer 4 LLM orchestration for clustering similar objects.
gotchas: Field validator clamps similarity_score silently without raising errors; floating-point edge cases (values like 1.0000000002 or -0.0000001) are absorbed by the clamp logic to avoid surfacing spurious validation errors to callers.
